variants.name: Chicken in Jelly 80 g
variants.about_this_item: Complete canned food for adult sterilised cats with chunks of chicken in jelly.
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: 75 % meat and animal derivatives in slices, including 34 % of chicken, cereals, vegetable by-products (sugar beet pulp, cellulose*), vegetable protein extract, minerals, oils and fats (salmon oil 0,22 %), fruits (banana 0,1 %, hawthorn 0,03 %)*, vegetable (tomatoes 0,11 %)*, ginger* 0,005 %.

Analytical constituents: crude protein 8,5 %, crude oils and fat 2,5 %, crude ash 2,2 %, crude fibre 0,96 %, humidity 82 %, calcium 0,25 %, phosphorus 0,22 %, magnesium 0,013 %, omega-3 fatty acids 0,09 %, omega-6 fatty acids 0,16 %.

variants.name: Rabbit in Jelly 80 g
